[ASSISTANT_SAID] Deep Breathing: Slow, deep breaths help calm the mind and body by providing more oxygen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Positive Self-talk: Encourage oneself with phrases like "I am confident and prepared" or "I can do this".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Visualization: Imagine a successful outcome to the situation or picture oneself in a calm and peaceful environment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reframing: Changing negative thoughts to positive ones by looking at the situation from a different perspective.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mindfulness: Focus on the present moment and be aware of one's thoughts and feelings, without judging or reacting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Progressive Muscle Relaxation: Tensing and relaxing muscles to release physical tension and stress.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Exercise: Physical activity like brisk walking or stretching helps to reduce stress and anxiety.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Time Management: Proper planning and prioritizing tasks help to reduce stress and anxiety.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Social Support: Talking to friends or family about the situation helps to relieve stress and anxiety.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Seeking Professional Help: Consult a psychologist, therapist, or psychiatrist to deal with severe stress and anxiety.
